title: Reading ability of Leon, Sharkey and the Hollywood sidemen
summary: Leon read better than Sharkey, who needed rehearsals. Pinero, the guitarist and the sax section are discussed as readers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: read music a lot better than Sharky. Could Sharky play second parts by ear?

Oh no, he, Sharky could read, but he, he was, he was a rehearsal reader, if you know what I mean. He'd have to rehearse a tune a few times to get it. But then, when, when we played the jazz tunes, Sharky would, uh, would run the brass section, you see.
They have many side readers in the band?
Well, I think Leon would have been a side reader. Panera was a side reader.
Oh. Frank, oh, Frank played fine. He was the one that later went with Louis.
